chunks: Some of our companions narrated from Khaythamah, who said:
Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said to me: “O Khaythamah,”

We are the tree of prophethood, the house of mercy, the keys of wisdom, the mine of knowledge, the locus of the message, the place where the angels come and go, the place of the secret of Allah, and we are Allah’s trust among His servants, and we are the greatest sanctuary of Allah, and we are the guarantee of Allah, and we are the covenant of Allah.
So whoever fulfills our covenant has fulfilled the covenant of Allah, and whoever violates it has violated the guarantee of Allah and His covenant.

key_terms.ذِمَّةُ اللَّهِ: the protected bond or guarantee belonging to Allah
key_terms.شَجَرَةُ النُّبُوَّةِ: the living root and lineage of prophethood
key_terms.مَعْدِنُ الْعِلْمِ: the source and repository of sacred knowledge
key_terms.مَفَاتِيحُ الْحِكْمَةِ: the means through which divine wisdom is accessed
key_terms.وَدِيعَةُ اللَّهِ: Allah’s trust deposited among His servants

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the status of the Imams عليهم السلام as Allah’s covenant and the heirs of prophetic knowledge?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام as the divinely designated locus of prophethood’s legacy, mercy, wisdom, and knowledge. It describes their sacred rank and identifies loyalty to them as loyalty to the covenant of Allah, highlighting their central theological and religious authority in Shia Islam.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad, from Al Khashhab who said, ‘Some of our companions narrated from Khusayma, who said,

We<sup>asws</sup> are the tree of Prophet-hood, and the House of Mercy, and keys of the Wisdom, and the Mine of Knowledge, and the receptacle of the Message, and an inter-change of the Angels (where Angels come and go), and a receptacle of the Secrets of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the depository among His<sup>azwj</sup> servants, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the Great Sanctity of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the Guarantee of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and we Are the Covenant of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>.

Therefore, the one who is loyal to our<sup>asws</sup> Covenant so is loyal with the Covenant of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the one who disregards it, so he has disregarded the Guarantee of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Covenant’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Adallah ibn Muhammad from al-Kashshab. He has said that a number of our people have narrated from al-Khaythama who has said that abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said to him the following.

we are the tree of prophet-hood, the house of blessings, the keys to wisdom, the mine of knowledge, the station of the Messenger-ship of (Allah), the center wherein the angels interchange and the place for the secrets of Allah. We are the trust of Allah among the people and we are the great Sanctuary of Allah. We are the promised responsibility of Allah and we are His covenant.
Whoever remains true to our covenant he has remained true to the covenant of Allah. Whoever disregards his covenant with us he has disregarded his covenant and responsibility towards Allah.”
